description: ALLOWED_LEAF_EXTENSIONS includes OID_EXT_EXTENDED_KEY_USAGE, OID_EXT_SUBJECT_KEY_ID, and OID_EXT_AUTHORITY_KEY_ID. pkix-path's HANDLED_CRITICAL_OIDS only covers KeyUsage, BasicConstraints, and SubjectAltName. If a cert has critical EKU (common in code-signing profiles), check_extensions passes it through the whitelist, then validate_path rejects it with PathError::UnhandledCriticalExtension, which surfaces as Error::Path(PathError::UnhandledCriticalExtension). The simplicity-gate error type (pkix_chain_simple::Error::UnhandledCriticalExtension) is never returned and the user gets a confusing wrapped Path error.
title: pkix-chain-simple: critical EKU in whitelist causes Error::Path not gate error
